request: Change the editor's blue text to black
summary: Every run whose colour is the editor's blue (0000FF, set directly or by its style) becomes Word's Automatic colour, as plain formatting; every other colour — hyperlinks, red text — stays as it is.
assumptions: the editor's blue is the colour 0000FF as the profiles show it; text coloured by a style counts as well as text coloured directly
black means Word's Automatic colour (auto), what the body text already has; say 000000 for an explicit black
the body only; headers and footers keep their colours
a whole-document recolour is plain formatting (decision 14.1); no words change
